question: What bath has been declared complete, and what practice is introduced for hearing next?
premises: The impurity-bath is declared as this completed teaching.
A transition marker introduces a new topic.
The listener is commanded to hear about the mantra-bath.
inference: Having concluded the teaching on the impurity-bath, the text now directs attention to the mantra-bath.
uncertainties: The precise ritual details of malasnāna and mantrasnāna are not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: This impurity-bath has now been declared; now hear about the mantra-bath.
